mechanics: Copies the three components of stack word 3 (oriented_vector) into the frame temporaries at P+0x14, P+0x18 and P+0x1C, and mirrors them into P+0x20, P+0x24 and P+0x28.

Loads the vtable word at creature+0xC0 and calls vtable slot +0x2C with ECX = creature+0xC0 and no stack arguments. This call is unconditional and executes at 0x00c1c604, before the creature+0x2B0 test at 0x00c1c611, and the returned const float* is parked in EDX at 0x00c1c60f. Only the component reads of that pointer, beginning at 0x00c1c61d, are gated.

Tests the 32-bit field at creature+0x2B0 with CMP and JNZ at 0x00c1c611 and 0x00c1c617; a non-zero value jumps to 0x00c1c791 and skips the component reads, the projection and the renormalization, leaving oriented_vector unchanged and the position callback result unused.

Compares the vtable+0x2C result against the twelve zero bytes at 0x0168D910 using UCOMISS, LAHF and TEST AH,0x44 with JP to the math at 0x00c1c656 and JNP to the skip at 0x00c1c791, so an unordered (NaN) component enters the math and a signed zero component compares equal.
The three component reads are short-circuited in source order: the +0x4 read is reached only when the +0x0 read compared equal, and the +0x8 read only when the +0x4 read compared equal.

Computes the reciprocal length of stack word 2 in x87 extended precision, accumulating the sum of squares as ((dx*dx + dy*dy) + dz*dz), applying FSQRT, then FDIVRP against 1.0, and narrowing once with FSTP to a single-precision frame temporary.

Scales the basis into unit components with three MULSS against the narrowed reciprocal, then accumulates the projection as (oy*uy + ox*ux) + oz*uz with MOVAPS, MULSS and ADDSS in that association order.
Subtracts the scaled basis with three MULSS and SUBSS pairs to obtain the perpendicular component, then repeats the zero-vector UCOMISS, LAHF and TEST AH,0x44 gate to decide renormalization.

On the renormalize path computes a second extended-precision reciprocal length of the perpendicular component and multiplies each component by it, storing the first component as inverse times x and the remaining two as component times inverse.
On the skip path executes FSTP ST0 at 0x00c1c78f, discarding the residual x87 register left by the earlier FSQRT and FDIVRP sequence.
Populates the locomotion request on the stack frame, submitting it by pointer through vtable slot +0xDC with ECX = creature+0xC0.
Stores stack word 1 into the 32-bit field at creature+0x0F98 after the submit call returns.

Branches on the byte at creature+0x0BB0; a non-zero byte calls the 0x00c0ce80 lookup with the constant pair 2 and 1 and adds the constant at 0x0150C900, a zero byte calls it with speed_state and 0 and adds nothing.
Narrowing the x87 result with FSTP to a frame temporary and then MOVSS to creature+0x2A0 performs a single narrowing of the sum, so the addition stays in extended precision.
Clears the 32-bit field at creature+0x330 to zero.

Loads ECX with the embedded container address creature+0xBC0 by LEA at 0x00c1c895, which persists unchanged into the container call, then reads that embedded object rather than the creature base: MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX + 0x4] yields creature+0xBC4 and MOV EDX,dword ptr [ECX] yields creature+0xBC0, and those two values are pushed in that order.
Calls 0x00ac4570 thiscall with ECX = creature+0xBC0 and the two stack words read from creature+0xBC0 and creature+0xBC4 in that order.
Reloads request+0x00, skips the release when it is null, otherwise reads the 32-bit header word at handle-0x04 and releases through 0x00f47380 only when that word is non-zero.
The release call is cdecl and the caller removes its single stack word with ADD ESP,0x4 at 0x00c1c8ce.

vector_math.position_callback_order: The vtable+0x2C position and basis callback is invoked unconditionally before the creature+0x2B0 bypass test, at 0x00c1c604 against the test at 0x00c1c611. A bypass value therefore suppresses only the dereference of the returned pointer and the projection, never the callback itself, so the callback's side effects and its cost are incurred on every invocation.

phase_one_gate.scope: gates only the component reads of the already-returned position pointer, not the callback

branches.effect: skip the component reads, the projection and the renormalization

branches.when: a basis component is NaN, because UCOMISS sets parity and JP is taken
the basis equals the zero triple with positive and negative zero both comparing equal

phase_one_gate.no_guard_on_basis_length: The basis length is never checked. A zero basis yields 1.0/0.0 as positive infinity, then 0.0 times infinity as NaN for every unit component, so the whole result becomes NaN and the request receives NaN. The reconstruction reproduces this instead of guarding it.

projection.association_order: The dot product is accumulated left to right as (oy*uy + ox*ux) + oz*uz. Each product is a single-precision multiply of a component by the already-narrowed unit component, not a multiply of the two raw components followed by a scale.
projection.reciprocal_length_model: The original accumulates the sum of squares in x87 80-bit extended precision, applies FSQRT, divides 1.0 by it with FDIVRP, and narrows once to binary32. The reconstruction accumulates in binary64 and narrows once to binary32; the intermediate precision difference is bounded by one unit in the last place of the sum and is recorded as a fidelity boundary rather than a behavioural claim.
projection.nan_propagation: NaN in any unit component propagates through the dot product and both subtractions, and the renormalization then yields NaN. No NaN check short-circuits the arithmetic.

renormalization_gate.condition: the perpendicular component differs from the zero triple, with NaN counting as different

branches.when: any component is NaN, because parity is set so the component counts as unequal
the perpendicular component is exactly the zero triple

renormalization_gate.skip_consequence: When the projection collapses to the zero vector the result is stored unnormalized, so request+0x50 can hold an exact zero triple.

embedded_container.receiver_evidence: LEA ECX,[ESI + 0xbc0] at 0x00c1c895 sets ECX to the embedded address and no instruction between there and CALL 0x00ac4570 at 0x00c1c8b6 rewrites ECX, so the thiscall receiver is creature+0xBC0 rather than the creature base.

embedded_container.staged_model: OpaqueEmbeddedContainer models the embedded object as begin_word at +0x00 and end_word at +0x04 and sizes itself to the remaining creature window tail so the address arithmetic stays in bounds without asserting a real extent.

state_evidence.projection_bypass_field: A non-zero 32-bit value at creature+0x2B0 bypasses the component reads of the position pointer, the projection and the renormalization. The position and basis callback still runs on every invocation, so the bypass suppresses arithmetic and dereference of the callback result but not the callback itself. The concrete field is not named by the SDK.
state_evidence.speed_mode_flag: A non-zero byte at creature+0x0BB0 replaces the lookup key and mode with the constants 2 and 1 and adds the constant 10.0f, isolating the speed scalar from stack word 1 while still publishing stack word 1 to creature+0x0F98.
state_evidence.container_call_receiver: The 0x00ac4570 receiver is the embedded object at creature+0xBC0, established by LEA ECX,[ESI + 0xbc0] at 0x00c1c895 which is not overwritten before the call. The two stack words are then read relative to that embedded receiver at its +0x00 and +0x04, which coincide with creature+0xBC0 and creature+0xBC4. The reconstruction forwards the embedded address and the two container-relative words; it does not forward the creature base.
state_evidence.container_call: 0x00ac4570 is a thiscall with ECX = creature+0xBC0 and two stack words. Its body copies 60-byte elements from the end word toward the begin word while the begin word differs from the container end, then advances the container end by the signed element count derived from begin minus end divided by 60. The reconstruction forwards the observed receiver and the two words without claiming the container type or its extent; only offsets +0x00 and +0x04 of the embedded object are observed.
state_evidence.identity: The function has no allocator and no cache, so repeated invocation with identical inputs and identical port behaviour yields identical field and request state.
state_evidence.fault_behavior: The vtable+0x2C result is dereferenced without a null check, but only when creature+0x2B0 is zero, so a null return faults at the first component read on the projecting path and is never dereferenced on the bypass path. Reads of later components are short-circuited, so a pointer exposing only the first real does not fault when that real compares equal to zero and the next is not read. The release handle is null-checked and its header word is read without a page guarantee.

Live decompilation exposes the reciprocal-length, dot-product and subtraction structure plus the creature+0x2A0, +0x330 and +0x0F98 stores; it renders stack word 1 as unaff_retaddr and the request base as an aliased local, which the disassembly resolves.

196 instructions with RET 0x14, the SUB ESP,0x90 and four-register prologue, both virtual call sites, the UCOMISS and LAHF and TEST AH,0x44 comparison gates, the SSE dot-product association order, the x87 FSQRT and FDIVRP and FSTP sequence, the sixteen request stores and the two-guard release. Re-inspected to confirm the call ordering: CALL EDX at 0x00c1c604 and MOV EDX,EAX at 0x00c1c60f both precede CMP dword ptr [ESI + 0x2b0],EBX at 0x00c1c611 and JNZ 0x00c1c791 at 0x00c1c617, and LEA ECX,[ESI + 0xbc0] at 0x00c1c895 precedes the container reads and CALL 0x00ac4570 at 0x00c1c8b6 with no intervening write to ECX.
Raw bytes f30f1019 d94108 d94104 through def2 d9c9 confirm the MOVSS loads, the FLD, FMUL, FADD, FSQRT, FLD1, FDIVRP, FXCH and FSTP reciprocal-length sequence and the FDIVRP at 0x00c1c699.
Raw bytes ending de f9 d9 5c 24 10 confirm the second reciprocal-length sequence and its single FSTP narrowing.
Twelve zero bytes, so the comparison constant is the zero vector and both signed zeros compare equal to it under UCOMISS.
Bytes a4 70 7d 3f decode to 0x3F7D70A4, the binary32 value 0.9900000095367432.
Bytes ff ff 7f 7f decode to 0x7F7FFFFF, the largest finite binary32.
Bytes 00 00 20 41 decode to 0x41200000, the binary32 value 10.0f.
Exactly three direct callees, 0x00ac4570, 0x00c0ce80 and 0x00f47380, with no other direct call target.
88 UNCONDITIONAL_CALL xrefs were reported, matching the caller-function total plus 11 unattributed sites.

Caller FUN_00c27dd0 pushes the constant 2, then EDX, then ECX, and two FSTP float stores before the call, which fixes the five stack arguments and cross-validates the SDK parameter order and the kStandardSpeed value 2.
The lookup takes this plus two stack words, returns 0.0 immediately when the first word is zero, otherwise indexes a float table and can interpolate between adjacent entries.
The first stack word is tested with TEST EAX,EAX as an integer key, and the epilogue is RET 0x8, so the function is callee-clean and stack word 1 is read as the raw 32-bit value.
thiscall with two callee-cleaned stack words, a 60-byte in-place element copy from the end word toward the begin word, and a container end advanced by a signed multiple of 60.
A null-tolerant single-argument release helper, matching the caller's ADD ESP,0x4.

verification.toolchain_note: clang is the reference toolchain for these packages. GCC rejects __attribute__((thiscall)) on non-class function pointer types under -Wattributes, which is the same pre-existing behaviour as the reference package reconstruction/staging/pkg13-c3-creature-progression-wave2 and is therefore not a regression introduced here.
